title: Bind interlocking trace assertions to the declared route (Bun)

facts.note: Bun realization scans only consumer e2e TypeScript tests.
Only e2e test files are in scope.
Bun stack; other stacks are owned by their own packages.
Non-gating hint only: task wording suggests interlocking trace tests are being written. The rule fires on the finding regardless of task wording.

values: test references bare `trace` identifier in an interlocking context (route/train/interlocking token or runner symbol)
facts.note: Content-level scan of the test file (comments masked) for a bare `trace` identifier plus interlocking context; provided by the bun_interlocking_coverage detector family. Any reference counts, with or without existing assertions.

fires: An e2e/**/*.ts interlocking test asserts on the TrainResult `trace` but only checks selectedTrainId.
An interlocking e2e test references or inspects `trace` without any assertions yet, and omits guardId or resolutionReason.
doesNotFire: An interlocking e2e test that never references the runtime `trace` object.
An e2e test with no interlocking route/train/interlocking token or runner symbol, even if it uses a `trace` variable.
Non-Bun stack renderings of interlocking trace tests.

given: A Bun e2e test (e2e/**/*.ts) in an interlocking context
when: it references or inspects the bare `trace` identifier (runtime trace on an interlocking execution's TrainResult), with or without assertions
then: Assert every required trace field — interlockingId, routeId, selectedTrainId, routeCategory, guardId, resolutionStrategy, resolutionReason — binding the executed route to its interlocking YAML declaration and resolution outcome.
prefer: Extend the flagged trace assertion so the captured trace is checked for all seven fields (TS camelCase).
Assert values against the interlocking YAML declaration the run came from.
avoid: Checking only one field (e.g. selectedTrainId): a different route/category/guard would still match.
Naming fields only in comments; comments are masked.
unless: The test does not reference the runtime `trace` object.
The test is non-interlocking (no interlocking route/train/interlocking token or runner symbol).
The stack is not Bun (owned by its own workspace package).
why: The TrainResult trace proves which declared route actually executed; a trace test that does not bind the declared route lets execution drift from declaration silently and undetected.
evidence: Every e2e/**/*.ts file referencing a bare `trace` identifier in an interlocking context contains assertions on all of interlockingId, routeId, selectedTrainId, routeCategory, guardId, resolutionStrategy, resolutionReason.
The bun_interlocking_coverage-family JS detector reports zero RAW violations for this rule.
verifier_detail: Detector: JS validator `tester.bun.interlocking-trace-binds-declared-route`, member of the `bun_interlocking_coverage` FAMILY; scans each interlocking-related test in the consumer's `e2e/**/*.ts`.

A file is a trace-binding test when it references a bare `trace` identifier in an interlocking context (any interlocking route/train/interlocking token or runner symbol); for such a file every required field token must appear (the test must assert every required trace field).
Required field tokens (TS camelCase): interlockingId, routeId, selectedTrainId, routeCategory, guardId, resolutionStrategy, resolutionReason.
Comments are masked before token search.
Any missing field is a RAW violation listing the gap (the missing fields).
Which per-stack discovery applies (here: Bun e2e/**/*.ts scanned for the trace object and the required field tokens) is delegated to this realization.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.1.0.

Bun-stack realization of agnostic core obligation `tester.interlocking.trace-binds-declared-route`; summary: an 'interlocking trace assertions bind the declared route' obligation rendered for the Bun backend.
Core design refs: afokapu/atdd#1246, afokapu/atdd#1248 (route space), afokapu/atdd#1251 (runtime trace / TrainResult trace and resolution outcome).
Term runtime_trace: the trace recorded on the TrainResult of an interlocking execution (core #1251); the evidence that ties an executed run to the declared route it came from.

Term required_trace_field: one of interlockingId, routeId, selectedTrainId, routeCategory, guardId, resolutionStrategy, resolutionReason — the fields a trace-binding test must assert so the executed route is bound back to its interlocking YAML declaration and resolution outcome.

sharedNodes.text: Disposition strict: the rule fails on every finding; no advisory mode.

additions.text: Assert values against the interlocking YAML declaration the run came from.
additions.justification: Makes the source's 'bind back to the declaration' intent (S006) concrete; no new obligation.

additions.text: Naming fields only in comments; comments are masked.
additions.justification: Direct coder-facing consequence of the source's 'comments masked' detector behaviour (S011), to prevent metric gaming.
Restatement of 'strict' (fails on every finding) as opposed to advisory; no baseline/ratchet policy is asserted since the source does not specify one.
